verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a dependency-free single binary that runs on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal, in Docker, or on Kubernetes. Self-hosters therefore control exactly where their documents and embeddings live, as in the community report of running it on a Hetzner box. For the managed cloud, a hands-on user confirms there are selectable regions (Singapore was the closest to them, with no Australian region), but the pack has no first-party documentation of this. Missing for 10: first-party docs on cloud region selection and the available region list, explicit data-residency guarantees or compliance commitments, and Australia/other regions not offered.
